minimized condensate while being easy to set up and use.

stability and performance.

**Performance with minimal contact. **The latest compact full-face CPAP mask from F&P Healthcare
features a floating seal and stability wings.

### Other Lincare Services

[patient with long term care provider]

##### [Disease Progression Management][79]

We provide a wide range of products and services to meet the needs of patients throughout every
stage of their disease process.

[DME MaleFemaleGroup StandingInGarden DriveCaneDriveWalker]

##### [Durable Medical Equipment (DME)][80]

Find a variety of durable medical equipment, from mobility aids to sleep therapy supplies. 

[EnteralBlackFemale
ClinicianStandingWhiteOlderFemalePatientSittingEnteralKangarooJoeyEnteralFeedPump]

##### [Enteral Therapy][81]

Our comprehensively trained dietitians help feed those who can't consume the calories they need.

[LINCARE AUG 254756]

##### [High-Frequency Chest Wall Oscillation (HFCWO)][82]

If your respiratory condition has you struggling to keep your lungs clear, HFCWO may be an effective
treatment you can do from home.

[INR WhiteCouple StandingInKitchenTesting RocheINRTestingMonitor]

##### [Home INR Testing][83]

Our PT/INR at-home testing allows Warfarin patients to monitor their blood anticoagulation levels at
home. 

[clinical employee looking at clipboard with patient]

##### [In-Home Disease Management][84]

For residents with chronic breathing disorders, our disease management programs may help them
achieve a higher health-related quality of life.

[Power Wheelchair in home]

##### [Lincare Powered Mobility][85]

Lincare Powered Mobility provides a variety of electric wheelchairs and scooters suited to meet
diverse needs.

[clinical employees looking at tablet together]

##### [Long-Term Care][86]

For residents with chronic breathing disorders, our long-term care services may help them achieve a
higher health-related quality of life.

[LINCARE DAY 11987]

##### [Nebulizer Therapy][87]

Lincare offers electronic and portable mist-inhaler solutions to fit your routine and respiratory
needs. 

[Oxygen WhiteMale SittingOnCouch OxygenConcentrator RespironicsEverflow 5LPM 2]

##### [Oxygen Therapy][88]

Home oxygen therapy is a treatment that provides supplemental or extra oxygen, it treats chronic
respiratory conditions.

[Pediatric Black Female Clinician White Family Young Boy Pediatric Wheelchair Living Room]

##### [Pediatric Services][89]

We tailor our pediatric treatments, whether they need respiratory therapy, enteral feeding pumps and
supplies, apnea monitors and more.

[Female Pharmacist with Laptop and Unit Dose Medications like Albuterol]

##### [Pharmacy][90]

Lincare Pharmacy Services delivers your medications straight to your home when you need them.

[Sleep Apnea BlackMaleOlderPatient Smiling SleepinginBed]

##### [Sleep Apena Therapy][91]

PAP treatment can help you breathe more easily during sleep, and can help eliminate snoring.

[young male using expression series device]

##### [Speech Generating Devices][92]

Living with speech disorders can be isolating, which is why we are committed to helping you gain the
power to communicate and connect.

[suction therapist working on patient]

##### [Trach & Suction Therapy][93]

Our personalized services support airway management and help improve respiratory health at home.

[LINCARE AUG 254869]

##### [Ventilator Care][94]

Non-invasive and invasive home ventilation can reduce the effort needed to breathe for patients with
chronic respiratory failure.

[hp Lifestyle WhiteFemaleWhiteMaleCouple BeachPalmTreesSand LookingatCamera]

"I want to thank Lincare for alerting us to Medicare cuts for home care products and services.
Lincare service has been a critical 'lifeline' for my husband in recent years. We thank you for your
commitment to us and all Medicare beneficiaries."

### Our Mission

Lincare's mission is to set the standard for excellence, transforming the way respiratory care is
delivered in the home. We are inspired by a vision to enable patients with chronic conditions to
remain engaged in life, with the peace of mind that we are caring for them.

# Live Chat!

Through our chat feature, all users can now quickly and easily contact the Lincare team. Access the
chat feature by clicking on the chat icon located at the bottom right-hand corner of the screen.
After verifying your identification, you will be connected with a live representative.

[Learn More About Live Chat][75]

# Your Lincare Services. Secure.

Experience a more efficient way to manage your Lincare services. The Lincare Patient Portal provides
secure, 24/7 access to your account, allowing you to place supply orders, manage billing, update
profile information, and view important documents with ease. Enroll today to take full advantage of
your digital care tools.

[Launch the New Patient Portal][76]

# What's Happening

Learn what’s happening across the Lincare community as we introduce new tools, celebrate company
achievements, and expand support for patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers nationwide. This
section brings you the latest news, program updates, educational resources, and innovations in
respiratory care, designed to keep you informed, empowered, and supported at every step of your
journey.

[patient with long term care provider]

##### [Disease Progression Management][79]

We provide a wide range of products and services to meet the needs of patients throughout every
stage of their disease process.

[DME MaleFemaleGroup StandingInGarden DriveCaneDriveWalker]

##### [Durable Medical Equipment (DME)][80]

Find a variety of durable medical equipment, from mobility aids to sleep therapy supplies. 

[EnteralBlackFemale
ClinicianStandingWhiteOlderFemalePatientSittingEnteralKangarooJoeyEnteralFeedPump]

##### [Enteral Therapy][81]

Our comprehensively trained dietitians help feed those who can't consume the calories they need.

[LINCARE AUG 254756]

##### [High-Frequency Chest Wall Oscillation (HFCWO)][82]

If your respiratory condition has you struggling to keep your lungs clear, HFCWO may be an effective
treatment you can do from home.

[INR WhiteCouple StandingInKitchenTesting RocheINRTestingMonitor]

##### [Home INR Testing][83]

Our PT/INR at-home testing allows Warfarin patients to monitor their blood anticoagulation levels at
home. 

[clinical employee looking at clipboard with patient]

##### [In-Home Disease Management][84]

For residents with chronic breathing disorders, our disease management programs may help them
achieve a higher health-related quality of life.

[Power Wheelchair in home]

##### [Lincare Powered Mobility][85]

Lincare Powered Mobility provides a variety of electric wheelchairs and scooters suited to meet
diverse needs.

[clinical employees looking at tablet together]

##### [Long-Term Care][86]

For residents with chronic breathing disorders, our long-term care services may help them achieve a
higher health-related quality of life.

[LINCARE DAY 11987]

##### [Nebulizer Therapy][87]

Lincare offers electronic and portable mist-inhaler solutions to fit your routine and respiratory
needs. 

[Oxygen WhiteMale SittingOnCouch OxygenConcentrator RespironicsEverflow 5LPM 2]

##### [Oxygen Therapy][88]

Home oxygen therapy is a treatment that provides supplemental or extra oxygen, it treats chronic
respiratory conditions.

[Pediatric Black Female Clinician White Family Young Boy Pediatric Wheelchair Living Room]

##### [Pediatric Services][89]

We tailor our pediatric treatments, whether they need respiratory therapy, enteral feeding pumps and
supplies, apnea monitors and more.

[Female Pharmacist with Laptop and Unit Dose Medications like Albuterol]

##### [Pharmacy][90]

Lincare Pharmacy Services delivers your medications straight to your home when you need them.

[Sleep Apnea BlackMaleOlderPatient Smiling SleepinginBed]

##### [Sleep Apena Therapy][91]

PAP treatment can help you breathe more easily during sleep, and can help eliminate snoring.

[young male using expression series device]

##### [Speech Generating Devices][92]

Living with speech disorders can be isolating, which is why we are committed to helping you gain the
power to communicate and connect.

[suction therapist working on patient]

##### [Trach & Suction Therapy][93]

Our personalized services support airway management and help improve respiratory health at home.

[LINCARE AUG 254869]

##### [Ventilator Care][94]

Non-invasive and invasive home ventilation can reduce the effort needed to breathe for patients with
chronic respiratory failure.

[hp Lifestyle WhiteFemaleWhiteMaleCouple BeachPalmTreesSand LookingatCamera]

"I want to thank Lincare for alerting us to Medicare cuts for home care products and services.
Lincare service has been a critical 'lifeline' for my husband in recent years. We thank you for your
commitment to us and all Medicare beneficiaries."

### Our Mission

Lincare's mission is to set the standard for excellence, transforming the way respiratory care is
delivered in the home. We are inspired by a vision to enable patients with chronic conditions to
remain engaged in life, with the peace of mind that we are caring for them.

# ADELAIDE CPAP SERVICE

your sleep care partners for Life!

[istockphoto-1156679499-170667a.jpg]

## WHAT IS SLEEP APNEA?

Sleep apnea is a sleep disorder that causes breathing to repeatedly stop and start during sleep.
This can lead to a decrease in the amount of oxygen in the blood, which can cause a variety of
health problems over time.


Common symptoms of sleep apnea include loud snoring, gasping or choking during sleep, excessive
daytime sleepiness, morning headaches, and difficulty concentrating. If left untreated, sleep apnea
can increase the risk of high blood pressure, heart disease, stroke, and other serious health
problems.


CPAP stands for Continuous Positive Airway Pressure, which is a type of therapy used to treat sleep
apnea. It involves the use of a machine that delivers a continuous stream of air through a mask worn
over the nose and/or mouth during sleep.


The air pressure helps keep the airway open, preventing episodes of apnea or hypopnea (shallow
breathing). CPAP therapy can significantly reduce the symptoms of sleep apnea, such as loud snoring,
excessive daytime sleepiness, and morning headaches.


There are different types of CPAP machines available, including fixed pressure machines,
auto-adjusting machines, and bi-level machines, which provide two different levels of pressure
during inhalation and exhalation. Our trained staff can help you determine which type of machine is
best for you.

## **Global Employee Benefit Programs**

Best in class global and local employee benefit programs for multinational corporations 

### **[Multinational
### Pooling][113]**
###  
###  
###  

Consolidates local employee benefit plans from two or more countries into one account (pool) to
assess the overall global result, enabling the client to receive a potential international
dividend.   

### **[Global
### Underwriting][114]**
###  
###  
###  

Based on the portfolio assessment, it replaces local pricing with global underwriting. This results
in more stable prices and better terms and conditions.

### **[ Captive
### Reinsurance][115]**
###  
###  
###  

Combines employee benefit plans from multiple countries into a corporate’s own captive via a
reinsurance mechanism allowing the company to manage its own risks. This program offers a
personalized online portal, providing access to high quality data analytics, insights and reporting.

### **[ Global
### Pension][116]**
###  
###  
###  

A central coordination of local solutions that helps multinational companies to increase governance
and efficiency across defined contribution (DC) plan and legacy defined benefit (DB) retirement
plans.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## **Consistent cover for your employees**

We understand that in today's globalized world, businesses often have employees spread across
different regions.  With our regional plans, you can ensure consistent and reliable coverage for
your employees worldwide. Our Summit plans are designed to meet the unique healthcare needs of each
region, while also ensuring compliance with local regulations. We provide administration services,
cover for insurance risks, or a combination of both.

You have access to a range of services gathered in one convenient hub to help protect you and your
family from preventable health risks. Our services include Telehealth Hub, Expat Assistance
programme, Fitness coaching App, Nutrition Hub, Travel Security and more.

## **What is global coverage health insurance?**

Global coverage health insurance is an international health insurance plan designed to provide
medical coverage for individuals living, working, or travelling abroad for extended periods. It
typically includes services like hospitalization, out-patient care, vaccinations, surgeries,
emergency evacuation, diagnostic tests and more.

## **How much does global health insurance cost?**

The cost of global health insurance varies based on factors such as number of members included in
the policy, destination countries, coverage level, pre-existing conditions and medical history (for
individual and small groups). Please [get in touch][132] with our sales team for a detailed quote.

## Short About Us

#### Looking for reliable industrial solutions?

PT. Andalira Cipta Abadi has been a trusted Authorized Distributor of [3M Indonesia][8] since 2003,
specializing in industrial tapes, adhesives, and abrasive products.

Starting from a small shop in North Jakarta, we have grown into a company with a 1,600 m² head
office located in the Jababeka Industrial Area, Cikarang, supported by branch offices in major
cities across Java.
* [Authorized Distributor of 3M Indonesia][9]

sensation, a new sound, and a new piece of equipment into an environment that your body associates

the experience is unfamiliar. Some people feel a sense of resistance when they exhale against the
pressurized airflow. This is normal. The machine is designed to maintain a set pressure to keep your
airway open, which means exhaling takes slightly more effort than it does without the machine. Most

sensation. You may also notice that your mouth feels dry when you wake. This is particularly common

nervous system need several nights to adjust to the sensation. Aerophagia Some first-time users
swallow air during the night, which causes bloating, gas, or discomfort in the morning. This happens

# MADE IN USA

## With domestic and globally sourced materials

[Headshot of Dennis Keiser in outdoor setting]
**“While our competitors are losing their manufacturing skills, we’re perfecting ours.”** DENNIS
KEISER CEO, Keiser Corporation

## Family values

The values we learned growing up on the farm run through our company — a sense of integrity,
dedication to work, and a commitment to one another. First and foremost, Keiser is a family company.

## Keeping jobs at home

We decided a long time ago, we couldn’t send our jobs overseas. So, we designed our machines to be
built at home. And we built a team that believes in Keiser, its mission, and each other to meet our
high standards.

## Owning our technology

We’ve always designed and built our own products. We don’t just design our machines to work better,
we make them to be better. And we keep our technology at home to give you the finest in
American-made quality.

## Perfecting our manufacturing

To compete with low-cost, foreign manufacturing, we’ve leaned out our processes and honed our
manufacturing skills. It hasn’t been easy, but while our competitors are losing their manufacturing
skills, we’re perfecting ours.

# MADE IN USA

## With domestic and globally sourced materials

[Headshot of Dennis Keiser in outdoor setting]
**“While our competitors are losing their manufacturing skills, we’re perfecting ours.”** DENNIS
KEISER CEO, Keiser Corporation

## Family values

The values we learned growing up on the farm run through our company — a sense of integrity,
dedication to work, and a commitment to one another. First and foremost, Keiser is a family company.

## Keeping jobs at home

We decided a long time ago, we couldn’t send our jobs overseas. So, we designed our machines to be
built at home. And we built a team that believes in Keiser, its mission, and each other to meet our
high standards.

## Owning our technology

We’ve always designed and built our own products. We don’t just design our machines to work better,
we make them to be better. And we keep our technology at home to give you the finest in
American-made quality.

## Perfecting our manufacturing

To compete with low-cost, foreign manufacturing, we’ve leaned out our processes and honed our
manufacturing skills. It hasn’t been easy, but while our competitors are losing their manufacturing
skills, we’re perfecting ours.

## Providing Solutions in Home Health Care for 25 + Years

Welcome to MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution, your community partner in home health care, assisted
living, retirement, and long-term care. When you need a wheelchair, a barrier-free bathtub, or even
physiotherapy equipment, you want assurance that your needs will be met by knowledgeable experts who
care about your independence and dignity. That’s where we come in! MED+ Home Health Care has worked
in your community for twenty five years to ensure that all community members maintain as much
mobility and independence as possible. So whether you choose to remain at home or move to one of
Ontario’s excellent long term care homes, you can buy or rent any custom medical equipment and
personal supplies that meet your needs.

We provide personal service, working with you and your caregivers through the entire process from
ordering, overnight delivery, through to custom fitting or training in the use of the products. Need
advice or help renovating your home to be wheelchair accessible or to ensure fall prevention? Want
to browse at your leisure through a store that displays the products you need? Or how about getting
help with that physiotherapy? MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution is here to help with all these
situations and more!

## [Stairlifts][75]

MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution has access to a large selection of stair lift products for your
home. We have custom stair lift solutions that can help you improve safety, mobility, and make it
easier to get up and down stairs inside or outside your home. Whether you are looking for a basic
stair lift, a unit for a curved staircase, or even a lift for stairs outdoors, we can help!

[Learn More][76]
[[Stairlifts]][77] [Learn More][78]

## WE ARE COMMITTED TO HELPING YOU STAY IN THE HOME YOU LOVE

Whether you are ageing or recovering from an injury, maintaining your independence is important to
you. For MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution it means a lot to us as well. We recognize your need to
have control over your life. We help you do this by providing medical equipment and products that
helps you maintain as much independence and comfort as you can, whatever your circumstances.

[Learn More][79]

### MED+ Is Proud to Be a Project Partner with Mike Holmes

As seen on Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy, MED+ is proud to partner with the Holmes family to
highlight the importance of accessibility and aging in place. Together, we showcased innovative
solutions, such as custom stairlifts and barrier-free designs, that make homes safe, functional, and
inclusive for people of all abilities. This collaboration underscores our shared mission to empower
Canadians with independence and dignity, creating spaces that truly work for everyone.

## Providing Solutions in Home Health Care for 25 + Years

Welcome to MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution, your community partner in home health care, assisted
living, retirement, and long-term care. When you need a wheelchair, a barrier-free bathtub, or even
physiotherapy equipment, you want assurance that your needs will be met by knowledgeable experts who
care about your independence and dignity. That’s where we come in! MED+ Home Health Care has worked
in your community for twenty five years to ensure that all community members maintain as much
mobility and independence as possible. So whether you choose to remain at home or move to one of
Ontario’s excellent long term care homes, you can buy or rent any custom medical equipment and
personal supplies that meet your needs.

We provide personal service, working with you and your caregivers through the entire process from
ordering, overnight delivery, through to custom fitting or training in the use of the products. Need
advice or help renovating your home to be wheelchair accessible or to ensure fall prevention? Want
to browse at your leisure through a store that displays the products you need? Or how about getting
help with that physiotherapy? MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution is here to help with all these
situations and more!

## [Stairlifts][75]

MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution has access to a large selection of stair lift products for your
home. We have custom stair lift solutions that can help you improve safety, mobility, and make it
easier to get up and down stairs inside or outside your home. Whether you are looking for a basic
stair lift, a unit for a curved staircase, or even a lift for stairs outdoors, we can help!

[Learn More][76]
[[Stairlifts]][77] [Learn More][78]

## WE ARE COMMITTED TO HELPING YOU STAY IN THE HOME YOU LOVE

Whether you are ageing or recovering from an injury, maintaining your independence is important to
you. For MED+ Medical Equipment Distribution it means a lot to us as well. We recognize your need to
have control over your life. We help you do this by providing medical equipment and products that
helps you maintain as much independence and comfort as you can, whatever your circumstances.

[Learn More][79]

### MED+ Is Proud to Be a Project Partner with Mike Holmes

As seen on Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy, MED+ is proud to partner with the Holmes family to
highlight the importance of accessibility and aging in place. Together, we showcased innovative
solutions, such as custom stairlifts and barrier-free designs, that make homes safe, functional, and
inclusive for people of all abilities. This collaboration underscores our shared mission to empower
Canadians with independence and dignity, creating spaces that truly work for everyone.

# Home

## 100 Million Happier, Healthier Birthdays

Together, we've already improved the lives of 40 million older adults. Now, we're building on that
momentum with a bold new goal: Creating 100 million happier, healthier birthdays by 2040.

[See How We're Driving Change][115]

## Our Mission

Creating the conditions for everyone to age well.

NCOA delivers the resources, tools, best practices, and advocacy our nation needs to ensure every
person can age with health and financial security—advancing our vision of 100 million happier,
healthier birthdays by 2040.

### Our Work

For more than 75 years, NCOA has driven change that helps people age with health, financial
security, and independence—and we're just getting started.

[Discover how we make a difference][116]
[A group of older adults is participating in a fitness class in a gymnasium. They are standing and
smiling, with chairs spaced out around them for support. The foreground features a woman with curly
hair wearing a black t-shirt and pink patterned pants, smiling at the camera. The gym has a wooden
floor and large windows in the background.]

### Our Promise

We believe every person deserves the opportunity to age well. Learn what guides our work and how
we're creating lasting change.

[Read our commitment to change][117]
[An older woman named Pat, wearing glasses and a patterned blouse, stands at the forefront of a
classroom setting with a smile. Behind her, several other older adults are seated at a long table,
engaged in an activity involving colorful materials. The room has bright lighting and educational
posters on the walls.]

## For every $1 raised, 93¢ supports NCOA programs that advance healthier, more secure aging.

[Donate][118][More Ways to Support NCOA][119]


## Our Partners Help Make Our Work Possible

Creating healthier, more secure futures takes collaboration. NCOA works with corporate partners and
foundations to expand our reach, accelerate impact, and help more people age well in every
community.

Ready to make a greater impact together?

[Partner with NCOA][120]
[Two people are wearing blue Nationwide shirts, where the shirt has the company's logo and the shirt
says 'Doing great things together.']

## Learn More About NCOA
* [Our History][121]
* [Our Finances][122]
* [Our Promise][123]
* [Our Partners & Sponsors][124]
* [Ways to Give][125]
* [Press Room][126]

## Data That Turns Our Mission Into Action

Latest NCOA Research

NCOA surveys and research reveal the realities of aging in America today. Explore the insights that
help drive solutions, inform action, and create more opportunities for people to age well.

[See the Data Driving Change][127]

## The Story Behind a Happier, Healthier Birthday

Every happier, healthier birthday starts with a story. Tell us about a moment, a person, or an
experience that has shaped how you think about aging. Your story may be featured on NCOA.org or in
our newsletters and social channels.

[Share Your Story with NCOA][128]
[Three senior women wearing sunglasses are outside in the sun, blowing confetti while at a birthday
party.]

## Get NCOA in Your Inbox

Choose where we'll send you resources to support your health and financial well-being. Select the
option(s) below that best describes you to get communication that matches your interests.

# Home

## 100 Million Happier, Healthier Birthdays

Together, we've already improved the lives of 40 million older adults. Now, we're building on that
momentum with a bold new goal: Creating 100 million happier, healthier birthdays by 2040.

[See How We're Driving Change][115]

## Our Mission

Creating the conditions for everyone to age well.

NCOA delivers the resources, tools, best practices, and advocacy our nation needs to ensure every
person can age with health and financial security—advancing our vision of 100 million happier,
healthier birthdays by 2040.

### Our Work

For more than 75 years, NCOA has driven change that helps people age with health, financial
security, and independence—and we're just getting started.

[Discover how we make a difference][116]
[A group of older adults is participating in a fitness class in a gymnasium. They are standing and
smiling, with chairs spaced out around them for support. The foreground features a woman with curly
hair wearing a black t-shirt and pink patterned pants, smiling at the camera. The gym has a wooden
floor and large windows in the background.]

### Our Promise

We believe every person deserves the opportunity to age well. Learn what guides our work and how
we're creating lasting change.

[Read our commitment to change][117]
[An older woman named Pat, wearing glasses and a patterned blouse, stands at the forefront of a
classroom setting with a smile. Behind her, several other older adults are seated at a long table,
engaged in an activity involving colorful materials. The room has bright lighting and educational
posters on the walls.]

## For every $1 raised, 93¢ supports NCOA programs that advance healthier, more secure aging.

[Donate][118][More Ways to Support NCOA][119]


## Our Partners Help Make Our Work Possible

Creating healthier, more secure futures takes collaboration. NCOA works with corporate partners and
foundations to expand our reach, accelerate impact, and help more people age well in every
community.

Ready to make a greater impact together?

[Partner with NCOA][120]
[Two people are wearing blue Nationwide shirts, where the shirt has the company's logo and the shirt
says 'Doing great things together.']

Every happier, healthier birthday starts with a story. Tell us about a moment, a person, or an

# Healthcare professionals

Inspire^{®} therapy may be a treatment option for your obstructive sleep apnea patients who are
unable to benefit from CPAP.

## What is Inspire therapy?

### Inspire therapy is a mask-free¹ solution for people with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) who have
### tried and struggled with CPAP. Through a simple-to-use system including the Inspire^{® }implant,
### remote and app, Inspire therapy enables patients to breathe regularly so they can sleep soundly.

[Learn more][35]

## Many of your patients may be eligible for Inspire therapy

### The FDA-approved Inspire implant is used to treat OSA in CPAP intolerant patients. Learn more
### about indications and contraindications for Inspire therapy.

[View requirements][36]

unable to benefit from CPAP.

## What is Inspire therapy?

### Inspire therapy is a mask-free¹ solution for people with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) who have
### tried and struggled with CPAP. Through a simple-to-use system including the Inspire^{® }implant,
### remote and app, Inspire therapy enables patients to breathe regularly so they can sleep soundly.

[Learn more][35]

## Many of your patients may be eligible for Inspire therapy

### The FDA-approved Inspire implant is used to treat OSA in CPAP intolerant patients. Learn more
### about indications and contraindications for Inspire therapy.

## Commitment to quality

### At Inspire Medical Systems, Inc. our focus on successful patient outcomes is paramount in
### everything we do. Our Quality Policy is our formal commitment to you that we will never waver in
### that regard.
### 
### Inspire therapy Quality Policy:
* Relentlessly pursue safe, effective, and reliable treatment of obstructive sleep apnea.
* Strive to consistently improve the quality of life of our patients and exceed customer
  expectations.
* Maintain rigorous processes that ensure compliance with applicable global laws and regulations.

## “Put the patient first and you will never lose your way!”

### Every OSA patient experience is different, but one aspect rings true for all—it’s excruciating
### to live with. When it comes to OSA treatment, CPAP is the standard of care. While it works for
### many, it doesn’t always work for everyone. When this happens, patients feel like they’re out of
### options and out of luck.

From its original founding in 2007, successful patient outcomes and care experiences have been the
guiding tenants for Inspire. Dr. Glen Nelson, Inspire’s first chairman of the board, established the
motto, “if we put the patient first, we will never lose our way.” This spirit guides us and has led
to significant investment in the Inspire post market surveillance system. Putting the patient first
requires a deep understanding of the experience today and a continuous focus on identifying ways to
make the experience better all the time.

Dr. Glen D. Nelson
Inspire Chairman of the Board 2007-2016

* Maintain rigorous processes that ensure compliance with applicable global laws and regulations.

## “Put the patient first and you will never lose your way!”

### Every OSA patient experience is different, but one aspect rings true for all—it’s excruciating
### to live with. When it comes to OSA treatment, CPAP is the standard of care. While it works for
### many, it doesn’t always work for everyone. When this happens, patients feel like they’re out of
### options and out of luck.

From its original founding in 2007, successful patient outcomes and care experiences have been the
guiding tenants for Inspire. Dr. Glen Nelson, Inspire’s first chairman of the board, established the
motto, “if we put the patient first, we will never lose our way.” This spirit guides us and has led
to significant investment in the Inspire post market surveillance system. Putting the patient first
requires a deep understanding of the experience today and a continuous focus on identifying ways to
make the experience better all the time.

Dr. Glen D. Nelson

## Innovation and
## High Quality Products

Pulmodyne strives to manufacture high quality products for healthcare providers, patients, and
distributors. We specialize in making disposable emergency airway products that are sold through our
global distribution channels. Our portfolio of products holds intuitive designs, enabling a rapid
administration to the providers hands.

[More About Us][23]
[Product]
[Arrow] [Arrow]

## Featured Products

We offer a complete line of airway and respiratory management products for use in Acute Care,
Prehospital/Emergency Medicine,
and Home Care Markets. Click on one of the categories below to explore our innovative products.
[Arrow] [Arrow]

## VT Select™

The VT Select is a manual resuscitator with a tactile feedback system. It is recommended by the AHA
to deliver 10 BPM of 500-600mL to a standard adult. When activated, the valve restricts the refill
of the bag to ~4 seconds. This provides your patient ~10 BPM, helping to eliminate hyperventilation
of the patient. When the valve is activated, press your thumb and three fingers simultaneously
together utilizing the finger ridges to deliver approximately 500-600mL to the patient.
Additionally, the BVM is smaller (1200mL) than most adult bags on the market. This helps to reduce
the risk of hyperinflation or barotrauma. The VT Select can be supplied with an optional PEEP valve,
Filter, and dial manometer

[Read More ][24]
[Brochure][25] [Product Video][26]

## EZ-Spray ™

#### **Powered Atomization Device**

The EZ-Spray was designed for rapid anesthetization of patients. It is a single patient use, closed
system, preventing the possibility of cross-contamination. Adjust the oxygen source to operate at
7-10 LPM according to desired flow rate. The 180° directional tip provides the ability to
effortlessly direct and deliver medication to the upper pharynx. It is a quick and thorough
anesthetization process.
* Directional Tip
* 60cc or 15cc Bottle
* Disposable, Single Patient Use

[Read More ][27]
[Brochure][28] [Find A Distributor][29]

## AccuPAP®

#### Lung Expansion Therapy in the palm of your hand

The AccuPAP provides positive airway pressure for the prevention and treatment of atelectasis. It
optimizes delivery of aerosolized medications with a T-piece adapter. There’s also adjustable PEEP
that makes it easy to adjust the pressures for the patient. Our PEEP technology is Independent of
the flow. This means that you can change your PEEP without worrying about changing the flow. The
PEEP settings are 5/10/15/20cm H2O.

[Read More ][30]
[Find A Distributor][31]

## DART ™

#### High-Quality Mucosal Atomization in the palm of your hands

Deliver medication quickly and painlessly with the DART. Atomized medication delivery results in
therapeutic onset delivery similar to intravenous delivery. There’s no special training required for
a system wide adoption. The delivery method is painless for the patient, helping them remain calm in
a high stress situation.
* Measure and deliver with accuracy
* NO IV line needed
* Available for all ages
* Approximately 50 Microns

[Read More ][32]
[Brochure][33] [Product Videos][34] [Find A Distributor][35]

## Control-Cric®

A surgical approach to a cricothyrotomy procedure. The Control-Cric® provides control by the simple
‘1,2,3’ step packaging. Each kit includes the following:
* Cric-Knife ™
* Cric-Key ™
* 10cc Syringe
* Silicone Neck Strap
* BVM Wedge
* 15mmFx22mmMExtension Tube with Double Swive

[Read More ][36]
[Brochure][37] [Product Videos][38] [Find A Distributor][39]

## O2-MAX®

#### **Nebulize from one tank!**

Continuous positive airway pressure is becoming the standard of care for patients suffering from
respiratory distress. The O2-MAX® system can deliver up to 140LPM of flow to the patient, with 30%
FiO2. Customize your FiO2 to increase from 30, 60, or 90% with the Trio adapter. Adjustable PEEP
options include a 3-SET™ (5/7.5/10cm H2O) or 5-SET™(5/7.5/10/12.5/15cm H2O)to suit a variety of
patient needs. Additionally, this completely disposable system offers integrated nebulization while
maintaining a consistent flow to the patient.

## Innovation and
## High Quality Products

Pulmodyne strives to manufacture high quality products for healthcare providers, patients, and
distributors. We specialize in making disposable emergency airway products that are sold through our
global distribution channels. Our portfolio of products holds intuitive designs, enabling a rapid
administration to the providers hands.

[More About Us][23]
[Product]
[Arrow] [Arrow]

## Featured Products

We offer a complete line of airway and respiratory management products for use in Acute Care,
Prehospital/Emergency Medicine,
and Home Care Markets. Click on one of the categories below to explore our innovative products.
[Arrow] [Arrow]

## VT Select™

The VT Select is a manual resuscitator with a tactile feedback system. It is recommended by the AHA
to deliver 10 BPM of 500-600mL to a standard adult. When activated, the valve restricts the refill
of the bag to ~4 seconds. This provides your patient ~10 BPM, helping to eliminate hyperventilation
of the patient. When the valve is activated, press your thumb and three fingers simultaneously
together utilizing the finger ridges to deliver approximately 500-600mL to the patient.
Additionally, the BVM is smaller (1200mL) than most adult bags on the market. This helps to reduce
the risk of hyperinflation or barotrauma. The VT Select can be supplied with an optional PEEP valve,
Filter, and dial manometer

[Read More ][24]
[Brochure][25] [Product Video][26]

## EZ-Spray ™

#### **Powered Atomization Device**

The EZ-Spray was designed for rapid anesthetization of patients. It is a single patient use, closed
system, preventing the possibility of cross-contamination. Adjust the oxygen source to operate at
7-10 LPM according to desired flow rate. The 180° directional tip provides the ability to
effortlessly direct and deliver medication to the upper pharynx. It is a quick and thorough
anesthetization process.
* Directional Tip
* 60cc or 15cc Bottle
* Disposable, Single Patient Use

[Read More ][27]
[Brochure][28] [Find A Distributor][29]

## AccuPAP®

#### Lung Expansion Therapy in the palm of your hand

The AccuPAP provides positive airway pressure for the prevention and treatment of atelectasis. It
optimizes delivery of aerosolized medications with a T-piece adapter. There’s also adjustable PEEP
that makes it easy to adjust the pressures for the patient. Our PEEP technology is Independent of
the flow. This means that you can change your PEEP without worrying about changing the flow. The
PEEP settings are 5/10/15/20cm H2O.

[Read More ][30]
[Find A Distributor][31]

## DART ™

#### High-Quality Mucosal Atomization in the palm of your hands

Deliver medication quickly and painlessly with the DART. Atomized medication delivery results in
therapeutic onset delivery similar to intravenous delivery. There’s no special training required for
a system wide adoption. The delivery method is painless for the patient, helping them remain calm in
a high stress situation.
* Measure and deliver with accuracy
* NO IV line needed
* Available for all ages
* Approximately 50 Microns

[Read More ][32]
[Brochure][33] [Product Videos][34] [Find A Distributor][35]

## Control-Cric®

A surgical approach to a cricothyrotomy procedure. The Control-Cric® provides control by the simple
‘1,2,3’ step packaging. Each kit includes the following:
* Cric-Knife ™
* Cric-Key ™
* 10cc Syringe
* Silicone Neck Strap
* BVM Wedge
* 15mmFx22mmMExtension Tube with Double Swive

[Read More ][36]
[Brochure][37] [Product Videos][38] [Find A Distributor][39]

## O2-MAX®

#### **Nebulize from one tank!**

Continuous positive airway pressure is becoming the standard of care for patients suffering from
respiratory distress. The O2-MAX® system can deliver up to 140LPM of flow to the patient, with 30%
FiO2. Customize your FiO2 to increase from 30, 60, or 90% with the Trio adapter. Adjustable PEEP
options include a 3-SET™ (5/7.5/10cm H2O) or 5-SET™(5/7.5/10/12.5/15cm H2O)to suit a variety of
patient needs. Additionally, this completely disposable system offers integrated nebulization while
maintaining a consistent flow to the patient.

# Home

SUNRISE
RESPIRATORY CARE
Are you at risk for obstructive
sleep apnea?
[LEARN MORE][45]

## OUR SERVICES

[[cpap-machine]][46]

# [Continuous, Positive Airway Pressure Systems][47]

[border_line]

We provide continuous, positive airway pressure systems (CPAPs and BiPAPs), and home healthcare
accessories for patients experiencing a variety of sleep apnea syndromes, along with other
respiratory related indications.

[[oxygentherapy]][48]

### [Oxygen Therapy in a Wide Variety of Delivery Systems][49]

[border_line]
We specialize in provision and delivery of home oxygen concentrators, portable concentrators, oxygen
tanks, and regulators.
[[Close-up of home caregiver and senior woman holding hands]][50]

### [Home-Based Respiratory Care with Licensed Respiratory Care Therapists][51]

[border_line]
We offer respiratory therapy care with licensed respiratory care therapists for patients requiring
home-based care.
[[Doctors shaking hands]][52]

### [Trusted Contractor for Healthcare Networks in Southern California][53]

[border_line]
We work with a full spectrum of health insurers to help patients obtain financial assistance and/or
coverage of approved applicable charges for equipment purchased or rented.

## ABOUT US

We are a Southern California-based retailer that offers a full spectrum of home-based medical
equipment and respiratory care services.
Sunrise Respiratory Care is a Southern California-based retailer that offers a full spectrum of
home-based medical equipment and respiratory care services. We are a company founded by physicians
specializing in pulmonary and sleep medicine along with experienced respiratory care therapists in
order to provide knowledgeable and comprehensive home-based respiratory care.
Sunrise Respiratory Care specializes in continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP/BiPAP) systems for
patients experiencing a variety of sleep apnea syndromes and other respiratory related indications.
Additionally, we offer a complete line of sleep apnea treatments including PAP systems,
humidification, supplemental oxygen, masks, and accessories.
[ LEARN MORE ][54]

## TAKING CARE OF
## YOUR SLEEP APNEA

## [Health Plans We Accept][55]

We are a trusted contractor for healthcare networks in Southern California. We work with a full
spectrum of health insurers.
[prescription]

## [Sleep Apnea Therapy Tips and Advice][56]

We make it our mission to help patients understand sleep apnea and how it affects them by offering
information about sleep disorders.
[doctor]

## [Licensed Respiratory Care Therapists][57]

Sunrise Respiratory Care offers respiratory therapy care for patients requiring home-based care, and
is available 24 hours a day
PRODUCTS WE OFFER
We offer a complete line of sleep apnea treatments including CPAP systems, humidification, masks,
supplemental oxygen, and other accessories.

TheNNT Rating System
**The Green Rating**
Therapies rated green are the best you can get
**The Yellow Rating**
Therapies rated yellow require more studies OR therapies with equal efficacy.
**The Red Rating**
Red suggest that benefits and harms may be equal or equivocal.
**The Black Rating**
Therapies rated black have very clear harms without any benefit.

## Highlighted Reviews

05/14/2026

### [Alpha-Lipoic Acid for Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy][43]

Alpha-lipoic acid shows little to no benefit over placebo for improving symptoms or impairment
[Read More][44]
04/30/2026

### [Testosterone Replacement in Men With Sexual Dysfunction in the Absence of Hypogonadism][45]

Testosterone replacement therapy shows no clear benefit over placebo
[Read More][46]
04/23/2026

### [Sustained-Release Naltrexone for Opioid Dependence][47]

Sustained-release naltrexone reduces illicit opioid use compared to standard care but shows slightly
worse outcomes than opioid agonists
[Read More][48]

## Recent Reviews

04/09/2026

### [Gonadotropins for Infertility in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome][49]

Gonadotropins increased live birth and clinical pregnancy rates
[Read More][50]
04/07/2026

### [Surgical vs. Nonsurgical Treatments for Carpal Tunnel Syndrome][51]

Surgery resulted in higher clinical improvement at long-term follow-up compared with splinting alone
[Read More][52]
03/31/2026

### [Higher Versus Lower Mean Arterial Blood Pressure Targets in Vasodilatory Shock][53]

Higher MAP targets are likely associated with increased 28-day all-cause mortality, less RRT-free
days, and increased risk of arrhythmia
[Read More][54]
02/17/2026

### [Extracorporeal Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation for Refractory Out-of-Hospital Cardiac Arrest][55]

Extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation did not improve favorable neurological status at the
shortest follow-up and at 6 months or reduce in-hospital mortality when compared to conventional
ACLS
[Read More][56]
02/12/2026

### [Intravenous Thrombolysis for Minor Acute Ischemic Stroke][57]

Intravenous thrombolysis lowered functional independence and increased deaths at 90 days
[Read More][58]
01/29/2026

### [Noninvasive Respiratory Support for Pediatric Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure][59]

Continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) reduced risk of invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV)
compared to standard oxygen therapy (SOT), while both CPAP and high-flow nasal cannula (HFNC)
reduced treatment failure compared to SOT
[Read More][60]

Please Wait, **Downloading** Section

We are a group of physicians that have developed a framework and rating system to evaluate therapies
based on their patient-important benefits and harms as well as a system to evaluate diagnostics by
patient sign, symptom, lab test or study.

We only use the highest quality, evidence-based studies (frequently, but not always Cochrane
Reviews), and we accept no outside funding or advertisements.

complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.

ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a

business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This

environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.

ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a

Компания **«Медурал»** занимается поставками медицинского оборудования и расходных материалов, имеет
офис в городе Екатеринбурге и ведет свою деятельность на территории Урала, по всей России и в
странах СНГ. «Медурал» предлагает широкий ассортимент продукции для физических лиц, стационаров,
лабораторий, частных клиник и медцентров.

Компания также открыта к сотрудничеству с практикующими докторами, благотворительными фондами,
лечебно-профилактическими учреждениями и деловыми партнерами.

Наш ассортимент включает современные приборы для диагностики и лечения, а также расходные материалы
и средства паллиативного ухода.

### Основные Преимущества компании «Медурал»:
* Быстрая доставка. В кратчайшие сроки заказы доставляются по всему региону, включая крупные города
  и небольшие населенные пункты. По запросу возможна доставка по всей территории России.
* Консультации специалистов. Опытные сотрудники помогают с выбором оборудования, основываясь на
  потребностях клиентов.
* Сертифицированная продукция. Все медизделия соответствуют требованиям качества и безопасности, что
  гарантирует их надежность и долгий срок службы.
* Сотрудничество с ведущими брендами. В каталоге доступны к покупке устройства от таких
  производителей, как WEINMANN LOEWENSTEIN, SCALEO, LONGFIAN, SEOIL PACIFIC, FISHER & PAYKEL, YUWELL
  и др.
* Гибкая система оплаты. Предлагаются различные способы оплаты, включая безналичный и наличный
  расчет.

**«Медурал»** предоставляет своим клиентам удобный интерфейс для поиска и заказа товаров, а также
регулярные акции и скидки на популярные позиции.
